rules.disease: Adult-type granulosa cell tumor of the ovary
rules.sentence: Stage is the most important prognostic factor, followed by tumor rupture, which indicates a worse prognosis.

rules.disease: Adult-type granulosa cell tumor of the ovary
rules.sentence: Large size (>15 cm) and bilaterality are unfavorable prognostic factors; however, the prognostic impact of size disappears when corrected for the stage.

rules.disease: Adult-type granulosa cell tumor of the ovary
rules.sentence: Homozygous FOXL2 mutation, higher FOXL2 mRNA expression, and chromosomal imbalance are associated with early relapse and worse outcomes.[35][36]

rules.disease: Adult-type granulosa cell tumor of the ovary
rules.sentence: Higher levels of SMAD3 expression are a novel predictor of recurrence in early-stage disease.[37]
